statement.excerpt: Anthropic’s desperation for new sources of compute also suggests that it’s bonking its head against the limits of its capacity, and will continue to do so as long as it continues to subsidize its users.
statement.document_title: Where Are All The Data Centers?

from_speaker: as long as it continues to subsidize its users
our_interpretation: The tentative statement about current capacity is background to a conditional forecast of continuing constraints.
Capacity constraints mean insufficient compute to meet customer demand, demonstrated by restrictions attributed to compute shortages. Ordinary commercial usage limits alone are insufficient.
Following the subscription context, subsidizing users means subscription receipts fail to cover the costs of serving those subscribers. Discounts from API prices do not establish this.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes subscription subsidies and capacity constraints throughout the ensuing subsidy period. An ongoing sequence of shortages can support the prediction provisionally but cannot settle its indefinite continuation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence establishes that capacity constraints ceased while subscriptions remained subsidized.
